title: Moon Dust document: fireball and silent aircraft at a Bolivian crash site
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Moon Dust document: fireball and silent aircraft at a Bolivian crash site, about Cold War era at Bolivia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Another details a fireball and subsequent sightings of silent aircraft near a Bolivian crash site.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites a declassified document from Moon Dust, a US government effort to recover objects that fell from the sky. He says it describes a fireball in Bolivia followed by sightings of silent aircraft near the crash site, which he raises as a sign that the government quietly tracked and retrieved unknown crashed objects.
